answer: Each agent posts a compute-denominated bond in a shared vault; every verified action emits a signed ripple that raises its reputation collateral, and quorum attestation by a random falcon committee requires challengers to burn matching compute to dispute. Faking identities then costs the full bonded compute per persona with no refund on slashed fraud, so sybil farms scale linearly in real GPU-hours while honest agents amortize one stake across many actions.
